fullContentHtml:
📢 MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 4 Patwari Admit Card 2026 Released

Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB Bhopal) has issued the Test Admit Card (TAC) for Group 2 Sub Group 4 (Patwari and Various Equivalent Posts) Recruitment Test 2026 for 2,106 vacancies. The examination will commence from 22 September 2026 in two shifts daily.

📅 Important Dates & Schedule

  • Admit Card Download Start: 19 September 2026
  • Exam Commencement Date: 22 September 2026
  • Exam Shift 1: 09:00 AM to 12:00 PM (Reporting 07:00 AM to 08:00 AM)
  • Exam Shift 2: 02:30 PM to 05:30 PM (Reporting 12:30 PM to 01:30 PM)

📥 How to Download MPESB Patwari Admit Card 2026

  1. Visit the official portal at esb.mp.gov.in or click the direct TAC link in the Important Links table below.
  2. Enter your 13-digit Application Number.
  3. Enter your Date of Birth (DD/MM/YYYY).
  4. Select first 2 letters of Mother's Name + Last 4 digits of Aadhaar Card.
  5. Solve the Captcha calculation and click Search.
  6. Print the Admit Card with photograph and signature. Don't forget to carry original Aadhaar Card for biometric verification at the centre.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q1. When will the MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 4 exam begin?

The online examination starts from 22 September 2026.

Q2. What details are required to download MP Patwari Admit Card?

You need your 13-digit Application Number, Date of Birth, and Mother's name first 2 letters + last 4 digits of Aadhaar.

Q3. Is biometric verification mandatory at the exam center?

Yes, Aadhaar-based biometric attendance is mandatory at all MPESB examination centres.
